attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Hawaii state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure with 12 brackets per Hawaii Department of Taxation (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Hawaii Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.hi_state_tax xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly

action_details.action_comment: Calculate HI tax for Single filers using progressive brackets
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.hi_standard_deduction_single sub 0 max dup /hi_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /hi_tax xdef
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_1_limit min result.hi_bracket_1_rate mul /hi_tax xdef
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_1_limit gt { hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_2_limit min result.hi_bracket_1_limit sub result.hi_bracket_2_rate mul hi_tax add /hi_tax xdef } if
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_2_limit gt { hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_3_limit min result.hi_bracket_2_limit sub result.hi_bracket_3_rate mul hi_tax add /hi_tax xdef } if
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_3_limit gt { hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_4_limit min result.hi_bracket_3_limit sub result.hi_bracket_4_rate mul hi_tax add /hi_tax xdef } if
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_4_limit gt { hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_5_limit min result.hi_bracket_4_limit sub result.hi_bracket_5_rate mul hi_tax add /hi_tax xdef } if
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_5_limit gt { hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_6_limit min result.hi_bracket_5_limit sub result.hi_bracket_6_rate mul hi_tax add /hi_tax xdef } if
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_6_limit gt { hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_7_limit min result.hi_bracket_6_limit sub result.hi_bracket_7_rate mul hi_tax add /hi_tax xdef } if
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_7_limit gt { hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_8_limit min result.hi_bracket_7_limit sub result.hi_bracket_8_rate mul hi_tax add /hi_tax xdef } if
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_8_limit gt { hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_9_limit min result.hi_bracket_8_limit sub result.hi_bracket_9_rate mul hi_tax add /hi_tax xdef } if
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_9_limit gt { hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_10_limit min result.hi_bracket_9_limit sub result.hi_bracket_10_rate mul hi_tax add /hi_tax xdef } if
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_10_limit gt { hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_11_limit min result.hi_bracket_10_limit sub result.hi_bracket_11_rate mul hi_tax add /hi_tax xdef } if
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_11_limit gt { hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_11_limit sub result.hi_bracket_12_rate mul hi_tax add /hi_tax xdef } if
hi_tax /result.hi_state_tax xdef hi_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Hawaii tax calculated (Single): $" result.hi_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate HI tax for Married Filing Jointly using progressive brackets
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.hi_standard_deduction_joint sub 0 max dup /hi_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /hi_tax xdef
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_1_limit_joint min result.hi_bracket_1_rate mul /hi_tax xdef
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_1_limit_joint gt { hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_2_limit_joint min result.hi_bracket_1_limit_joint sub result.hi_bracket_2_rate mul hi_tax add /hi_tax xdef } if
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_2_limit_joint gt { hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_3_limit_joint min result.hi_bracket_2_limit_joint sub result.hi_bracket_3_rate mul hi_tax add /hi_tax xdef } if
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_3_limit_joint gt { hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_4_limit_joint min result.hi_bracket_3_limit_joint sub result.hi_bracket_4_rate mul hi_tax add /hi_tax xdef } if
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_4_limit_joint gt { hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_5_limit_joint min result.hi_bracket_4_limit_joint sub result.hi_bracket_5_rate mul hi_tax add /hi_tax xdef } if
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_5_limit_joint gt { hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_6_limit_joint min result.hi_bracket_5_limit_joint sub result.hi_bracket_6_rate mul hi_tax add /hi_tax xdef } if
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_6_limit_joint gt { hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_7_limit_joint min result.hi_bracket_6_limit_joint sub result.hi_bracket_7_rate mul hi_tax add /hi_tax xdef } if
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_7_limit_joint gt { hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_8_limit_joint min result.hi_bracket_7_limit_joint sub result.hi_bracket_8_rate mul hi_tax add /hi_tax xdef } if
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_8_limit_joint gt { hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_9_limit_joint min result.hi_bracket_8_limit_joint sub result.hi_bracket_9_rate mul hi_tax add /hi_tax xdef } if
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_9_limit_joint gt { hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_10_limit_joint min result.hi_bracket_9_limit_joint sub result.hi_bracket_10_rate mul hi_tax add /hi_tax xdef } if
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_10_limit_joint gt { hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_11_limit_joint min result.hi_bracket_10_limit_joint sub result.hi_bracket_11_rate mul hi_tax add /hi_tax xdef } if
hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_11_limit_joint gt { hi_taxable_income result.hi_bracket_11_limit_joint sub result.hi_bracket_12_rate mul hi_tax add /hi_tax xdef } if
hi_tax /result.hi_state_tax xdef hi_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Hawaii tax calculated (MFJ): $" result.hi_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Hawaii military retirement income exclusion. Provides 100% exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments. National Guard/Reserve pay exempt up to $8,636 (2025). Honors MSRRA (spouse income exempt if different domicile) and SCRA (active duty pay exempt if different state of residence). Per HI Rev. Stat. § 235-7 (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Hawaii Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0 /result.hi_military_retirement_exclusion xdef 0 /result.hi_sbp_exclusion xdef 0 /result.hi_guard_reserve_exclusion xdef 8636 /result.hi_guard_reserve_limit xdef

action_details.action_comment: Apply full exclusion for military retirement pay and limited exclusion for Guard/Reserve pay
